title: Full Body Turbo
description: 3-round circuit mixing squats, wide push-ups, lunges, plank and burpees for a complete full body session

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower thighs parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate front left and front right with no pause

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: On your forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace your abs

exercises.name: Burpees without push-up
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
